scripts.d1:pull: npm run d1:apply:local && npm run d1:export && wrangler d1 execute thelongrun --local --file=.wrangler/d1-backup.sql
scripts.d1:counts:local: wrangler d1 execute thelongrun --local --command="SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM runs) AS runs, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM routes) AS routes, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM planned_routes) AS planned, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM context) AS context"
scripts.d1:counts:remote: wrangler d1 execute thelongrun --remote --command="SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM runs) AS runs, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM routes) AS routes, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM planned_routes) AS planned, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM context) AS context"
